subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the context of the given sentence.**

You should donate your __old__ clothes to the poor.
solution:
The correct answer is '**new**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**old**' is '**new**'.
 
• **Old**: having lived for a long time; no longer young. (Hindi: पुराना)
 
 
• *Example: My grandfather is very **old**, while my brother is young and full of energy.*
 
 
 
• **New**: not existing before; made, introduced, or discovered recently. (Hindi: नया) 
 
 
• *Example: I bought a **new** dress for the party.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *New.*

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **__Confusion Points__***

__
 
• Young cannot be the correct answer as the sentence is talking about clothes and young refers to the early stage of life or growth.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning** of other words:

 
 
• **Young**: being in the early stage of life or growth; not old. (Hindi: युवा, नवजात)
 
• **Modern**: relating to the present or recent times as opposed to the remote past. (Hindi: आधुनिक)
 
• **Fresh**: not previously known or used; new or different. (Hindi: ताजा, नया)
